name: smb-mna-multiples
title: SMB & Lower-Middle-Market M&A Valuation Multiples (ExitValue.ai)
description: Open dataset of median EV/EBITDA and EV/Revenue valuation multiples for small-business and lower-middle-market M&A, by sub-vertical and enterprise-value bracket, derived from 25,000+ real, verifiable transactions (SEC EDGAR 8-K/S-4 filings, fairness opinions, verified press releases). No estimated or imputed values; every cell requires n >= 10 disclosed deals. Source window: 2018-2026. Built and maintained by ExitValue.ai — full methodology at https://exitvalue.ai/methodology and the State of SMB & Mid-Market M&A report at https://exitvalue.ai/research

resources.name: multiples
resources.description: Per (sub-vertical x EV-bracket) median + p25/p75 EV/EBITDA and EV/Revenue multiples with deal counts. 140 cells, each n >= 10.

resources.name: multiples-by-year
resources.description: Per (sub-vertical x year) date-stamped quartiles, [2018, 2026]. 186 cells, each n >= 10.
